risks.description: Authentication service has had 3 outages in the last month; a launch-day outage is plausible
risks.evidence: 3 incident reports in the last 30 days (P1-level severity)

risks.description: CSV export does not handle unicode characters correctly
risks.evidence: We think the export could break for some accounts

risks.description: No automated monitoring alerts for the new data pipeline
risks.evidence: Pipeline deployed 2 weeks ago; only manual log checks exist currently

risks.description: A major competitor might copy our feature within weeks
risks.evidence: Competitor's last release was 9 months ago; their team is focused on a different market segment

risks.description: Users might not discover the new analytics dashboard
risks.evidence: Dashboard is the new default landing page; usability test showed 100% discovery rate

risks.description: The PM who originally championed this feature has left the company; nobody has re-validated requirements with current customers
risks.evidence: PM departed 6 weeks ago; no customer interviews since then; team has been building to the original spec

risks.description: The team is experiencing burnout after 3 consecutive crunch sprints; quality may be declining
risks.evidence: Two engineers mentioned burnout in 1-on-1s; PR review thoroughness has visibly dropped
